notes: Search coverage: ~12 web searches covering Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Devin, Amazon Q, Windsurf, job postings, GTC, and earnings/exec quotes. STRONGEST evidence is for Cursor (official Cursor case study + multiple Huang public quotes) and OpenAI Codex (official OpenAI case study + NVIDIA's own blog + reputable news on the 10,000-employee rollout). Claude Code internal-use evidence is weaker: it derives mainly from Huang's GTC 2026 keynote naming all three tools together; no dedicated Anthropic case study naming NVIDIA's internal Claude Code teams/scale was found (the Claude Code + NIM page is a product integration). NO credible NVIDIA-specific internal-use evidence was found for GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q Developer, Windsurf, Devin, Gemini CLI, or Antigravity; Copilot results were ecosystem/product-integration noise (JFrog, jetson-copilot, NIM provider) and Microsoft-internal stories, not NVIDIA dogfooding. CAVEATS: Vendor case-study pages (cursor.com, openai.com) and several news pages returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch, so figures rely on search-result extracts and corroborating secondary sources; multiple sources agree on the 30,000 (Cursor case study)/~40,000 (Huang) engineer figures and 3x code metric, and on the 10,000-employee Codex rollout. The 30,000 vs 40,000 discrepancy likely reflects Cursor-specific developer count vs Huang's total-engineer framing.
